description: Source code for MCU (Microcontroller Unit) initialization and configuration in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including clock setup, reset handling, and core identification.

methods.name: Mcu_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MCU with provided configuration, checks CPU support, resets stats, enables interrupts.

methods.name: Mcu_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the MCU (simple reset of global state).

methods.name: Mcu_InitRamSection
methods.description: Initializes a RAM section; not supported for external RAM.

methods.name: Mcu_InitClock
methods.description: Initializes the system clock based on specified clock setting.

methods.name: Mcu_DistributePllClock
methods.description: Distributes the PLL clock; not implemented on this hardware.

methods.name: Mcu_GetResetReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for the last reset.

methods.name: Mcu_GetResetRawValue
methods.description: Returns raw reset cause register value.

methods.name: Mcu_PerformReset
methods.description: Performs a system reset using hardware reset feature.

methods.name: Mcu_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the MCU mode (not fully implemented).

methods.name: McuE_GetSystemClock
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current system clock frequency.

methods.name: McuE_GetPeripheralClock
methods.description: Returns peripheral clock frequency based on type.

methods.name: Mcu_ConfigureFlash
methods.description: Configures internal flash for optimal performance.
